changelog.change: I Veteris now supports Community Apps with a dedicated category and various other improvements. Recommended versions of an App are now highlighted. You can now see detailed information about each version, instead of only information about the app as a whole. New app icon for iOS 7 and above. Coming soon: More information about apps, including guides on how to fix them. The badge on the Home tab can now be disabled. Fixed the hitboxes of some Cancel buttons in action sheets. Bug fixes and various other small improvements.
